common.noscript: This site uses a small JavaScript layer for language switching and project cards. The core content is still available without it.
home.hero.title: Every workplace is a world when you are small.
home.hero.lead: Carry the lunchbox. Cross the impossible construction site. Find your way back to her.
home.world.label: First stop
home.world.name: The construction site
home.world.eyebrow: A small delivery through a brutal world
home.world.title: Ordinary places. Monstrous scale.
home.world.body: Kiddo turns the adult world into a hostile playground of steel, dust and impossible heights. Fight through workers, improvise with what you find, and keep moving toward the person waiting at the end.
home.world.feature2: Action roguelite combat and strange tools
home.world.feature3: A child's fear, curiosity and stubborn courage
home.mission.title: It is only a lunchbox. It is the whole mission.
home.mission.body: Food, health and purpose travel in the same battered blue box. Every room puts a little more distance between Kiddo and the person it belongs to.
home.arsenal.eyebrow: Use whatever the world leaves behind
home.arsenal.title: A child's arsenal
home.arsenal.hint: Choose an item, then try it in Kiddo's test bench.
home.arsenal.item.notebook.name: Notebook
home.arsenal.item.notebook.description: Sketch the room, mark the danger, then pretend this was the plan all along.
home.arsenal.item.potion.name: Questionable Potion
home.arsenal.item.potion.description: A fizzing shortcut from terrified to much too fast.
home.arsenal.item.paperStar.name: Paper Star
home.arsenal.item.paperStar.description: Homework becomes a sharp little argument at range.
home.arsenal.item.fries.name: Cold Fries
home.arsenal.item.fries.description: Regain courage one suspicious floor fry at a time.
home.arsenal.item.bat.name: Wooden Bat
home.arsenal.item.bat.description: Simple, loud and extremely convincing at arm's length.
home.arsenal.item.water.name: Water Bottle
home.arsenal.item.water.description: Catch your breath, then launch back into the impossible.
home.arsenal.item.ammo.name: Ammo Box
home.arsenal.item.ammo.description: The box is tiny. The confidence it provides is not.
home.arsenal.item.candy.name: Wrapped Candy
home.arsenal.item.candy.description: Explosive energy now; consequences after the next room.
home.arsenal.item.brick.name: Loose Brick
home.arsenal.item.brick.description: Gravity does most of the work. Kiddo takes the credit.
home.arsenal.item.basketball.name: Basketball
home.arsenal.item.basketball.description: One throw, several bounces, no reliable prediction.
home.arsenal.item.jacks.name: Jacks
home.arsenal.item.jacks.description: Turn an ordinary walkway into everybody else's problem.
home.arsenal.item.cutlery.name: Pizza Cutter
home.arsenal.item.cutlery.description: Roll the blade through the crowd and carve the room into manageable slices.
home.arsenal.item.bread.name: Bread Slice
home.arsenal.item.bread.description: Soft, dependable and just enough to stand back up.
home.arsenal.item.sock.name: Lost Sock
home.arsenal.item.sock.description: Vanish in one direction and reappear somewhere less sensible.
home.identity.role: Dark games, sharp prototypes, strange little systems

home.projects.subheading: Kiddo leads the way. These are the public projects behind the studio.

about.hero.title: Black Cat Glass
about.hero.lead: Black Cat Glass is a small indie game dev studio currently focused on Kiddo, with older public prototypes like cyberpunk-shootout showing the road here.
about.mission.heading: What we make
about.mission.subheading: Dark game projects built by a small team.
about.mission.body1: The studio is shaped around compact, playable experiments: systems-first games, moody spaces, and ideas that feel a little hostile in the best way.
about.mission.body2: Public pages only show projects and information meant to be shared. Internal repositories, revenue, and business plans stay off the site.
